task: Implement LPN generation and validation on inbound receiving. Each incoming pallet unit gets a traceable License Plate Number; validate against staging queue to prevent duplicates.
checklist: Vendor barcode is validated against inbound_staging_queue to prevent duplicates
If no barcode exists, a unique UUID-based LPN is generated
API returns 201 Created and triggers LPN label printing
Manual vendor selection is limited to the active counterparties list
Negative: duplicate barcode -> duplication warning, no second registration
Edge: barcode present but not in queue -> clear error, pallet sent to quarantine, NOT accepted silently
Edge: label printer offline -> registration state stays consistent with a retry path
Audit: who registered the pallet, when, and by which method (scan/manual)
